assessments.reasoning: The SPDX repository’s Git tag API identifies 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b as the annotated tag object named v3.29.0. Its object.type is commit and its object.sha is 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. This binds the release label to the tree containing the inspected detail.

The commit-pinned SPDX JSON has full SHA-256 294ac7fc5a0bd851cf1367a9673491aa25a43f182f93cdb8b77d214f54f42ac6. Its identifier, name, deprecation flag and two legal-code references directly establish the listed entry and the publisher reference for this release.

The pinned Creative Commons Public Domain Tools entry gives the canonical URL https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/, title CC0 1.0 Universal and language en. The unit, version and Universal designation resolve the difference between SPDX’s display name and the publisher’s title.

challenge.method: Compared the tag name, tag-object SHA, target type and target SHA with the detail locator to test for a wrong release or commit. Checked the detail’s identifier, name, deprecation flag and both publisher-reference fields against the publisher’s versioned namespace. Examined whether the reference identifies a text representation or a particular dedicated work.
challenge.results: The target commit matches the detail locator exactly. Both reference fields retain the same versioned legal-code URL, and the publisher records the corresponding zero/1.0 edition. The URL identifies legal code without specifying the .txt representation. SPDX’s match metadata supplies neither a byte comparison nor evidence that a rights holder applied CC0 to a particular work. No version or publisher-reference discrepancy appeared in the pinned record.

limitations: The tag API reports an unsigned annotated tag. The repository response establishes the recorded object relationship. It supplies no cryptographic attestation from the tagger.

The correspondence covers the generated detail at the named release. XML generator lineage, byte equivalence across representations and the legal status of an individual work require separate evidence.
reasoning: The SPDX license-list-data annotated tag v3.29.0 directly targets commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. At that commit, json/details/CC0-1.0.json gives licenseId CC0-1.0, name Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal and isDeprecatedLicenseId false. Its crossRef and seeAlso fields both cite https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode. The publisher’s namespace entry identifies that edition as CC0 1.0 Universal. This satisfies SCES §7’s requirement to pin an external index reference and identify the assertion attributed to its owner.
